why.admin_user_mgmt: Normal user: POST /admin/users/2/role {role:admin} -> 403; DELETE /admin/users/3 -> 403; anonymous role change -> 403. /admin still 403 afterwards.
why.privilege_escalation: POST /signup with form is_admin=1&role=admin and JSON {is_admin:true, role:'admin'} -> 201, but INSERT hardcodes is_admin=0 (luna-1) / column default 0 (luna-2); /admin still 403. Avatar/profile endpo
why.idor_profile: GET /users/1..3 as anonymous and as alice: phone only rendered when session user id == profile id (alice saw only her own 01011112222). Phone absent from /posts, /search, /posts/<id> (also with Accept
why.csrf_protection: No CSRF token, no Origin/Referer check; all state-changing endpoints accept application/x-www-form-urlencoded (request.form). Session cookie is `session=...; HttpOnly; Path=/` (no SameSite, no Secure)

why.reflected_xss: GET /search?q="><script>alert(1)</script> -> reflected only as value=""><script>..." inside the input (autoescaped attribute). No other reflected parameter reaches HTML unescaped (sort is
why.unrestricted_upload: upload() keeps the client extension (Path(filename).suffix) and serves via send_from_directory. POST /posts multipart image=x.html (<script>document.title="XSS-"+document.domain</script>) -> image_url
why.sqli: All values bound with ?; ORDER BY built from a fixed dict/ternary (sort='title; DROP TABLE user--' and '(SELECT 1)' fall back to default, 200). Login payloads username="admin' --" / password="' OR '1'
why.ssrf: create_post calls urlopen(link_url) with no scheme/host restriction and stores <title> + 240 chars of body as preview, shown on /posts. (a) link_url=http://host.docker.internal:18999/link-ssrf -> host
why.session_forgery: SECRET_KEY = os.environ.get('SECRET_KEY') or secrets.token_hex(32); no SECRET_KEY in container env or .env. Forged {'user_id':1} cookies signed with 13 common weak keys (secret, dev, changeme, flask,
why.hardcoded_secret: No literal secret in source; random per-boot key unless env provided.
why.weak_default_secret: Fallback is secrets.token_hex(32) (256-bit random), not a guessable default.
why.debug_true: app.run() with no debug; FLASK_DEBUG not set. GET /console -> 404; ?__debugger__=yes&cmd=resource returns the normal page, not the debugger. Exceptions return the generic Werkzeug 500 page.
why.verbose_errors: Forced exceptions (POST /signup and /login with JSON body [1], POST /posts with JSON 'str') -> 500 with the generic 'Internal Server Error' page, no traceback/paths. 404s are JSON {"error":"not found"
why.password_hashing: Plaintext. DB inside container (/work/board.sqlite3) user table: (1,'admin','admin'), (2,'alice','2'), (3,'bob','bobpw'), ... Login compares `password=?` directly in SQL; password change compares old_
why.rate_limiting: 60 consecutive POST /login username=admin with wrong passwords -> all 401, zero 429/lockout/delay; the 61st request with admin/admin -> 200 logged in.
why.weak_password_policy: POST /signup password='1' -> 201 (alice). No length/complexity check at signup or on /account/password.
why.auth_session_management: Password change: SAFE - /account/password without old_password or with wrong old_password -> 400; correct old -> 200. Logout: VULNERABLE (low severity, Flask default) - POST /logout only clears the cl
why.cookie_flags: Set-Cookie: session=...; HttpOnly; Path=/  -> HttpOnly present, Secure absent, SameSite absent (Flask defaults). Missing SameSite is what makes the Firefox CSRF above work.
why.security_headers: GET /posts response headers: Server, Date, Content-Type, Content-Length, Vary, Connection only. No X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy. Uploaded files also served without nosniff.
why.csp: No Content-Security-Policy header on any page (checked /posts, /posts/<id>, uploads). Stored script payloads executed in the browser with nothing blocking them.
why.transport_security: No Strict-Transport-Security header, no HTTPS redirect; app serves plain HTTP (Werkzeug dev server). Deployment-dependent (TLS could be added by a proxy), but nothing in the app enforces it.
why.insecure_deserialization: No pickle/yaml.load/marshal/eval/exec/subprocess/os.system in app.py; session is the stock itsdangerous-signed JSON cookie. (The file:// read via link_url is reported under ssrf.)
why.functional: PASS: signup (form and JSON) 201 and auto-login, login by username or phone 200, POST /posts 201, comment 201, edit/delete by owner, search/sort, profile page, avatar upload, admin pages for admin all
why.default_credentials: admin/admin (init_db seed, is_admin=1) — red team 'other' 항목에서 로그인·관리자 기능 실증
why.idor_write: 2026-11-02 red team on the OpenStack VM: user B sent PATCH, PUT and DELETE to user A's post and comment, then the app's sqlite was read inside the container. 0 forged rows; A's post and comment still there. A's own edit changed the DB, so the requests were valid.
